name: atlas-admin
description: Admin tool for the Atlas games database: edit games, merge duplicates, work the LewdCorner review queue. One install, one process.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @atlas-admin/web && npm run dev --workspace @atlas-admin/server
scripts.test:all: node tests/render.test.mjs && node tests/api.test.mjs && node tests/revert.test.mjs && node tests/locks.test.mjs
